items.topic: 硅谷科技从业者中“永久底层阶级”说法的流行及其背后的社会流动数据
items.real_title: Silicon Valley's Strange New Obsession

fewshot.thesis: 硅谷对“永久底层”的恐慌搞错了重点：AI并没有新造出一个阶层，社会流动在几十年前就已经停滞，AI只是让最后几个上升通道也关上了。

Why Tech Workers Are Racing To Get Rich Before AI Arrives

guide_v1.title: Tech Workers Are Racing To Escape The Permanent Underclass... Too Late
guide_v1.thesis: “永久底层”焦虑并非AI新产物，向上流动早已在房价、学费和工会衰落中失灵；AI只是把硅谷最后一条逃生通道也关掉。
candidates: Silicon Valley's Fear Of The "Permanent Underclass"
Tech Workers Are Racing To Escape The Permanent Underclass... Too Late
If AI Takes Your Job Before You Retire... Are You Stuck Forever?

fewshot.title: Your Data Is Worth Billions... Just Not To You
fewshot.thesis: 个人数据被企业近乎零成本收集转售，用来在贷款、求职、保险和定价中给你定价，而你得不到任何回报。
candidates: Your Life Is For Sale (And Honda Only Gets 26 Cents)
The Secret Industry That Decides Your Credit, Your Job, and Your Insurance
Your Data Is Worth Billions... Just Not To You
fewshot.judge_reason: 引用口语“Dude I'm Broke”，怪趣味像真人
fewshot.thesis_reason: 都说数据被用来给你定价，真实还强调AI替代和比本人值钱

guide_v1.title: Your Data Is Worth More Than You Are
guide_v1.thesis: 个人数据早已不只是广告燃料：它决定你的薪水、保费、房租和价格，你却拿不到一分钱，AI还在吞掉最后的免费数据。
candidates: You Are The Product... And You're Being Sold Cheap
Your Data Is Worth More Than You Are
The Data Economy Knows Exactly What You'll Pay
guide_v1.judge_reason: 引用口语句式很独特，AI 不太会这样写
guide_v1.thesis_reason: 都说数据超广告价值，真实核心是数据比人值钱

guide_v2.title: How Companies Secretly Sell Your Entire Life
guide_v2.thesis: 个人数据不只是拿来推广告：存储成本趋零后，信用、就业、保险、定价和AI都靠它给人打分，最后用来收你更多的钱，而且你没办法退出。
candidates: Your Data Is Worth More Than You Are
How Companies Secretly Sell Your Entire Life
The Data Economy Is Genuinely Far Scarier Than Big Brother
guide_v2.judge_reason: 引号口语加自嘲，新奇不套路
guide_v2.thesis_reason: 都说数据被用来压价、打分和训练AI，最终损害个人

zero.title: The Hidden Economy Selling Your Life
zero.thesis: 个人数据早已从信用档案变成定价、雇佣和AI的核心资产，被收集者承担代价，企业和数据商拿走全部收益。
candidates: You Are the Product: How Your Data Became a $30 Billion Industry
The Hidden Economy Selling Your Life
How Companies Turned Your Data Into Their Money
zero.judge_reason: 引号里的口语化台词，B是AI常见的泛化说法
zero.thesis_reason: 方向一致，仿写侧重收益分配不均

items.topic: 美国政治资金的各类渠道、规模、规则漏洞及相关改革尝试
items.real_title: America's "Unsolvable" Problem
items.real_thesis: 美国政治金钱的真实规模远超公开披露的游说数字，且多条合法渠道与旋转门激励嵌入体制，仅靠竞选财务改革无法根治。

fewshot.title: Buying Congress Is The Best Investment In America
fewshot.thesis: 美国政治捐款限制形同虚设，游说是回报率最高的投资，普通选民的偏好几乎左右不了政策。
candidates: Buying Congress Is The Best Investment In America
How $10 Billion (Legally) Buys American Politics
Why Campaign Finance Limits Are A Joke
fewshot.judge_reason: 短标题加引号反讽，类似“The 'Skills Gap' Myth”
fewshot.thesis_reason: 都说金钱政治管不住，重点分别是隐藏规模和选民无力

guide_v1.title: How To (Legally) Buy A Politician
guide_v1.thesis: 美国政治腐败多数是合法的：超级PAC、暗钱和旋转门让富人与企业每1美元游说换回数百倍回报，普通选民的偏好几乎不影响政策。
candidates: How To (Legally) Buy A Politician
Your Vote Is Worth Nothing... Their Money Is Worth 220x
The $10 Billion Business Of Buying Washington
guide_v1.judge_reason: 用引号讽刺某个词是频道的常见手法
guide_v1.thesis_reason: 都讲合法渠道金钱政治，真实重在规模和改革无效

guide_v2.title: How Billionaires Legally Buy American Politics
guide_v2.thesis: 美国政治腐败多数并不违法。超级PAC、暗钱、游说和旋转门把买政策变成高回报投资，普通人的偏好几乎影响不了政策，改革也一再在国会被卡住。
candidates: How Billionaires Legally Buy American Politics
Your Vote Doesn't Matter (Their Money Does)
The $10 Billion Industry Of Buying Congress
guide_v2.judge_reason: 简短加引号反讽，符合频道惯用写法
guide_v2.thesis_reason: 都说合法渠道难改，但真实重在规模被低估

zero.title: How Billionaires Legally Buy Washington
zero.thesis: 美国政治资金的漏洞是刻意保留的，游说回报率高达220倍，政策实际由出钱者而非选民决定。
candidates: How Billionaires Legally Buy Washington
The $10 Billion Industry That Writes America's Laws
Why Your Vote Matters Less Than Their Money
zero.judge_reason: 引号反讽"Unsolvable"，A更像直白概括
zero.thesis_reason: 均指金钱操控政治，重点在规模与刻意漏洞不同

items.topic: 大型科技公司近年裁员的规模、成本、股权薪酬背景及AI裁员后的回聘情况
items.real_title: Big Tech Cut 950,000 Jobs... And Then Hired Them All Back
items.real_thesis: 大科技公司裁员既没省钱也没提效，员工总数已回到原点；真正动因是高层打压员工、控制RSU股权稀释，AI只是说辞。

fewshot.title: Big Tech's Layoffs Were Never About Saving Money
fewshot.thesis: 科技巨头裁员并非为降本或被AI取代，而是为作废未归属股权、取悦投资者，最终常要高价回聘。
candidates: Big Tech's Layoffs Were Never About Saving Money
Why Big Tech Fires Thousands... Then Hires Them Back
The "AI Layoffs" That AI Didn't Actually Cause
fewshot.judge_reason: 具体数字加夸张反转；B像AI式的论断句
fewshot.thesis_reason: 都说裁员不为降本或AI，而是为了股权控制

guide_v1.title: Big Tech Layoffs Are NOT About Saving Money
guide_v1.thesis: 大科技裁员几乎不省钱、员工总数也没降：它是在股票归属前砍人、用“AI”取悦股东的表演，代价是人才流失和高价回聘。
candidates: Big Tech Layoffs Are NOT About Saving Money
If AI Replaced Everyone... Why Are They Hiring Them Back?
The Great Tech Layoff Scam
guide_v1.judge_reason: 大写NOT是反常识观点句式；A的数据过于夸张
guide_v1.thesis_reason: 都说不省钱、AI是说辞，动因归结不同

guide_v2.title: Why Big Tech Keeps Firing People It Needs
guide_v2.thesis: 大厂裁员不是因为AI提高了效率。裁员能让未归属的RSU作废、少花回购的钱、换个说法讨好投资人，但被裁的岗位多数又以更高成本招回来，真正吃亏的是员工和入门级新人。
candidates: Big Tech's Layoffs Are A Lie
Why Big Tech Keeps Firing People It Needs
The AI Layoff Scam - Who Actually Saves Money?
guide_v2.judge_reason: 具体数字加省略号反转，是典型钩子
guide_v2.thesis_reason: 都说AI只是说辞，RSU是真动因，岗位又招回来了

zero.title: Big Tech's Layoffs Aren't About AI
zero.thesis: 科技巨头裁员主要是为了作废未归属股票、节省回购资金，AI只是好听的借口，最终往往高价回聘。
candidates: The Layoff Lie: Why Big Tech Fires People It Needs
Big Tech's Layoffs Aren't About AI
Why Firing Workers Is Secretly Profitable for Big Tech
zero.judge_reason: 省略号转折加夸张数字，接近频道风格
zero.thesis_reason: 都称AI是借口，动因侧重股权但细节不同

items.topic: 职业体育球队估值上涨的原因及其资金来源与税务机制
items.real_title: How Sports Predicted "The Everything Bubble"
items.real_thesis: 体育球队运营上是烂生意，但因富豪激增与稀缺供给、税务折旧优惠、主权资金和博彩流媒体涌入而成了资产泡沫式的好投资。

fewshot.title: Why Billionaires Keep Paying Record Prices For Teams That Don't Make Money
fewshot.thesis: 球队估值暴涨不是因为经营赚钱，而是富豪借它避税，加上主权基金、博彩和转播资金涌入推高了价格。
candidates: Why Billionaires Keep Paying Record Prices For Teams That Don't Make Money
The $12 Billion Tax Shelter That Plays Basketball
Sports Teams Have Become The Ultimate Billionaire Loophole
fewshot.judge_reason: 跳跃式联想加引号；A冗长，像解释性AI标题
fewshot.thesis_reason: 经营不赚钱，靠避税和外部资金推高估值

guide_v1.title: Why Billionaires Lose Money On Sports Teams (On Purpose)
guide_v1.thesis: 球队估值暴涨不是因为能赚钱，而是亿万富翁扎堆、摊销避税、主权基金和博彩资金涌入，账面亏损恰恰是富豪的避税工具。
candidates: Why Billionaires Lose Money On Sports Teams (On Purpose)
If Sports Teams Barely Make Money... Why Are They Worth $12 Billion?
The Sports Team Tax Shelter
guide_v1.judge_reason: 联想跳跃大，带引号概念，不像对选题的直译
guide_v1.thesis_reason: 运营不赚钱但因富豪、避税、主权与博彩资金升值

guide_v2.title: Why Sports Teams Are Suddenly Worth So Much
guide_v2.thesis: 球队估值暴涨不是因为它赚钱。亿万富翁越来越多而球队数量有限，再加上税务摊销、转播合同和博彩资金，球队成了富人的避税奢侈品，最后由球迷和青少年家庭买单。
candidates: Why Sports Teams Are Suddenly Worth So Much
Sports Teams Are The Billionaire Tax Shelter
WTF Happened To Sports Team Prices?
guide_v2.judge_reason: 引号概念加意外关联，B过于平铺直叙
guide_v2.thesis_reason: 都说不赚钱，但靠稀缺、税务优惠和外部资金成了好投资

zero.title: Why Billionaires Pay Billions for Teams That Lose Money
zero.thesis: 球队估值暴涨并非因为能赚钱，而是富豪太多、球队稀缺，加上无形资产摊销让球队成为合法避税工具。
candidates: Why Billionaires Pay Billions for Teams That Lose Money
The Real Reason Sports Teams Are Worth $10 Billion
Sports Teams Are the Ultimate Billionaire Tax Shelter
zero.judge_reason: 引号加宏观关联视角，B是常见套路句式
zero.thesis_reason: 均为不赚钱但稀缺富豪避税推高估值

items.topic: 贝莱德限制旗下信贷基金赎回，及私募信贷市场的规模、增长原因与风险数据
items.real_title: Is Private Credit About To Crash The Global Economy?
items.real_thesis: 私人信贷在银行退让与私募股权热潮中过度膨胀，优质借款人耗尽、利率上升、违约攀升，已具备引发新一轮金融危机的系统性风险。

fewshot.title: BlackRock Just Locked The Exits... Private Credit Is Cracking
fewshot.thesis: 规模已超当年次贷的私募信贷正通过银行敞口外溢风险，贝莱德限制赎回是这个市场开始破裂的信号。
candidates: BlackRock Just Locked The Exits... Private Credit Is Cracking
The $3 Trillion Bubble That's Bigger Than Subprime
Private Credit Is Wall Street's Next Big Mistake
fewshot.judge_reason: A的“Locked The Exits…Cracking”戏剧化过头，像AI写的
fewshot.thesis_reason: 都警示私募信贷危机，成因和信号重点不同

guide_v1.title: BlackRock Just Locked The Exit... Who's Holding The Bag?
guide_v1.thesis: 贝莱德限制赎回暴露了私募信贷的本质：3万亿高息贷款互相嵌套，违约率创新高，而银行敞口暴增，风险最终会回流到公众身上。
candidates: Private Credit Is The New Subprime (probably)
The $3 Trillion Loan Nobody Can Get Out Of
BlackRock Just Locked The Exit... Who's Holding The Bag?
guide_v1.judge_reason: B的“锁门/接盘”比喻过于工整，像 AI 写的
guide_v1.thesis_reason: 都警示系统性风险，成因侧重点不同

guide_v2.title: The Private Credit Bubble - Is 2008 Happening Again?
guide_v2.thesis: 私募信贷不是银行之外的安全替代品。它和私募股权层层加杠杆、互相接盘，利率上升后违约创新高，银行的风险敞口也越来越大，可能需要纳税人救助，不过银行体系比2008年更扛得住。
candidates: Private Credit Is Starting To Crack
The Private Credit Bubble - Is 2008 Happening Again?
Wall Street's $3 Trillion Shadow Bank Is Breaking
guide_v2.judge_reason: B用破折号再比作2008，像AI套路
guide_v2.thesis_reason: 方向一致，仿写说银行更扛得住，结论比真实弱

zero.title: BlackRock Just Locked the Exits: The Private Credit Bubble Is Cracking
zero.thesis: 贝莱德限制赎回说明规模已超次贷的私募信贷开始破裂，且银行敞口激增，风险可能蔓延到整个金融体系。
candidates: BlackRock Just Locked the Exits: The Private Credit Bubble Is Cracking
Private Credit Is Bigger Than Subprime Was in 2008
The $3 Trillion Debt Bomb Nobody Is Watching
zero.judge_reason: B用冒号叠加两个短句，像AI仿写
zero.thesis_reason: 都认为私募信贷破裂具系统性风险
